environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instances in a public subnet behind an Application Load Balancer. The S3 bucket 'promotional-assets-internal' has a permissive bucket policy allowing PutObject from any principal in the account. No rate limiting configured on the ALB. The application uses the default S3 endpoint (gateway endpoint exists but with no restrictive policy). Instances run with an IAM role granting s3:PutObject and s3:GetObject on both buckets without conditions.

config.compute: EC2 t3.medium, Node.js 18, single-threaded event loop
config.network: Public subnet, ALB with no rate limiting, no WAF
config.s3_endpoint: Default S3 gateway endpoint, policy: Allow *
config.concurrency: No request deduplication, no distributed locking
